executive_summary: CISA and GitHub report 15 active vulnerabilities across web apps, cloud, and containers. Focus on 5 with lab-testable scenarios for portfolio projects.

signals.title: WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion (CVE-2026-87902)
signals.what_changed: Improper sanitization allows local .php file inclusion via page-template resolution
signals.why_it_matters: Enables RCE in unpatched WordPress instances; common in portfolio projects
signals.application: Deploy vulnerable WordPress in Docker; test path traversal payloads in theme templates

signals.title: Zammad Privilege Escalation (CVE-2026-102490)
signals.what_changed: Local zammad user can escalate to root via improper privilege checks
signals.why_it_matters: Demonstrates privilege chain attacks; relevant for Linux security studies
signals.application: Run Zammad in VM; exploit session fixation (CVE-2026-102489) then escalate privileges

signals.title: gitea-runner Container Namespace Leak (GHSA-x4q3-gcj3-m6cf)
signals.what_changed: Privileged mode disabled but host namespaces/capabilities still passed to job containers
signals.why_it_matters: Critical for CI/CD pipeline security; enables host-level container escapes
signals.application: Configure gitea-runner in Kubernetes; demonstrate host namespace access via crafted jobs

signals.title: probe-image-size SVG Parser DoS (GHSA-gjj5-9665-rwrc)
signals.what_changed: Quadratic-time complexity in SVG parsing causes CPU exhaustion
signals.why_it_matters: Teaches resource exhaustion defense; applicable to image processing pipelines
signals.application: Generate malicious SVG files; test in local image processing service to trigger DoS

signals.title: Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal (CVE-2026-104286)
signals.what_changed: NULL byte bypass allows arbitrary file write via crafted HTTP requests
signals.why_it_matters: Illustrates input validation failures; relevant for web server hardening
signals.application: Simulate FortiMail API in Flask; test path traversal payloads to write files outside webroot

experiment.title: Defensive Testing: WordPress RFI Mitigation
experiment.objective: Demonstrate secure coding practices to prevent CVE-2026-87902 exploitation
steps: 1. Deploy vulnerable WordPress in Docker with default config
4. Implement input validation: sanitize $_GET['template'] with basename() and realpath()
5. Add allowlist for valid template paths in wp-config.php
experiment.stop_condition: Mitigation prevents file inclusion; no system access achieved

discarded: Citrix, Cisco, Apple, Microsoft, Arista, F5, WSO2, Adobe advisories - no lab-testable scenarios or duplicate CVEs
